purpose: Read-only source provenance; not live campaign data

values: Canonical terminology, schema rules, controlled vocabulary, and FOIMS-X presentation contracts.
Live campaign data and runtime state.
This is an authoring workbook. Native C++ owns live campaign records, validation, strategic time, and save data.
Use stable IDs. Never use actor pointers, TIDs, spawn order, row numbers, or temporary map references as persistent identity.
A future compiler validates this workbook and emits game data. Do not read Excel directly at runtime.
Do not rename released IDs. Deprecate records and write migrations instead.
Actor; NPC pointer; Row Number; TID; Spawn Order

Field actor is only temporary presentation
Display Row; Name Key; Actor ID

Use Cat suffix only for reusable definitions matrices dictionaries or static rule structures

Use Remediation for reusable corrective intervention definition

Use Location for persistent strategic place with stable ID and capabilities
Do not use GZDoom object identity
